remarks: Step into this welcoming 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in the highly sought-after Village Walk community of Wilton! This beautifully updated unit is bathed in natural light and brimming with modern style including hardwood flooring, crown molding/trim, fireplace with custom mantel, offering the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. The main floor welcomes you with an open-concept living and dining space, ideal for both entertaining and unwinding. The kitchen features granite counters, ample cabinetry and stainless appliances. A versatile main-floor bedroom and renovated full bath complete this level-perfect for guests, a home office, or even a cozy retreat. Upstairs, you'll find a generous primary suite with a full bath. Don't miss the opportunity to make this impeccable condo your home, ideally located just a short walk to Wilton Town Center. This unit also features a one-car garage with generous extra storage space. Experience the best of Wilton living with its top-rated schools, scenic surroundings, beautiful parks and trails, vibrant community, and easy access to shopping, dining, and commuting options
